args.title: Game carries out its actions
args.description:
The application calls these methods on Game by exactly these names and keyword arguments. Each one changes the object as described.
- Field `status` holds exactly one of: "Ready" (New game, no cell opened yet, no mines laid, timer at 0); "Playing" (First cell opened; mines laid and timer running); "Won" (Every non-mine cell is opened; board locked); "Lost" (A mine was opened (directly or by a chord); board locked); "Abandoned" (Left from Ready or Playing via restart, difficulty change or closing; no score)
- Field `cells[].state` holds exactly one of: "Hidden" (Not opened and not flagged); "Flagged" (Marked by the player (or auto-flagged mine on a win); cannot be opened); "Opened" (Safe cell revealed, showing adjacent_mine_count); "Detonated" (The mine cell the player opened, causing the loss)
- Field `difficulty_id` holds exactly one of: "beginner" (9×9, 10 mines); "intermediate" (16×16, 40 mines); "expert" (30 wide × 16 high, 99 mines); "custom" (Player-chosen width 9–30, height 9–24, mines 10 to (width−1)×(height−1); no best time)
- A refusal raises `InvalidConfigurationError` when change_difficulty receives an unknown difficulty_id, or Custom width, height or mine_count outside the allowed limits; the message states the limits and the game is unchanged
- A refusal raises `CellNotFoundError` when open_cell, toggle_flag or chord_cell names a row or column outside the grid
- A refusal raises `InvalidTransitionError` when an internal status or cell-state change outside the allowed set is attempted. Allowed status changes are Ready→Playing, Playing→Won, Playing→Lost and Ready/Playing→Abandoned. Allowed cell changes are Hidden↔Flagged, Hidden→Opened and Hidden→Detonated. Ignored player actions never raise it.
args.given_when_then: Given a Game in a state where the action is allowed (arrange that by setting its fields). When a Game is created with only its required fields and nothing is called on it Then Constructed with id, difficulty_id, width, height, mine_count, remaining_mines and created_at: status 'Ready', mines_laid False, flags_placed 0, elapsed_seconds 0, remaining_mines equal to mine_count, started_at, ended_at and struck_cell_id None, events empty. cells holds width×height dicts in row-major order, with zero-based row and column and id f"{row}-{column}" (e.g. '0-0'). Each cell has has_mine False, adjacent_mine_count 0 and state 'Hidden'. When `open_cell(row, column)` is called with valid values Then Opens the cell at zero-based (row, column), and is allowed only while status is Ready or Playing. On the first open of a Ready game, mines_laid becomes True and exactly mine_count mines are placed at random on cells other than the opened one. Every cell's adjacent_mine_count is then set to its mines among the existing up-to-8 neighbours, status becomes Playing and started_at is set. A Hidden safe cell becomes Opened; if its count is 0 the cascade opens Hidden neighbours, repeating through zeros, stopping at numbered cells and skipping Flagged cells. If the cell holds a mine it becomes Detonated, struck_cell_id holds its id, status becomes Lost, ended_at is set and elapsed_seconds freezes. When the last non-mine cell is opened, status becomes Won, ended_at is set, every mine cell is set to Flagged, flags_placed equals mine_count and remaining_mines is 0. Opening an Opened, Detonated or Flagged cell, or opening any cell in a Won, Lost or Abandoned game, changes nothing and raises no error, and the object's fields show it afterwards. When `toggle_flag(row, column)` is called with valid values Then Switches a Hidden cell to Flagged (flags_placed +1) or a Flagged cell back to Hidden (flags_placed −1), and is allowed only while status is Ready or Playing. Afterwards remaining_mines = mine_count − flags_placed, which may go negative; flags are unlimited. Toggling an Opened or Detonated cell, or any cell in a Won, Lost or Abandoned game, changes nothing and raises no error, and the object's fields show it afterwards. When `chord_cell(row, column)` is called with valid values Then Applies only to an Opened cell with adjacent_mine_count N ≥ 1 while status is Playing. If exactly N of its neighbours are Flagged, every Hidden neighbour is opened exactly as open_cell would, including cascades, a win, or a loss if a neighbour is a mine (that cell becomes Detonated, struck_cell_id is set and status becomes Lost). If the flag count differs from N, the cell is Hidden, Flagged or a zero cell, or the game is not Playing, nothing changes and no error is raised, and the object's fields show it afterwards. When `tick()` is called with valid values Then The clock advancing one second: while status is Playing, elapsed_seconds increases by 1, capped at 999. In any other status nothing changes, and the object's fields show it afterwards. When `restart_game()` is called with valid values Then Pressing the smiley. If status is Ready or Playing it becomes Abandoned and ended_at is set; if Won or Lost the outcome is kept. Returns a new Game with a new id and the same difficulty_id, width, height and mine_count, in its starting state, and the object's fields show it afterwards. When `change_difficulty(difficulty_id, width, height, mine_count)` is called with valid values Then Choosing a difficulty from the menu: beginner gives 9×9 with 10 mines, intermediate 16×16 with 40, expert 30×16 with 99. Custom uses the given width (9–30), height (9–24) and mine_count (10 to (width−1)×(height−1)); out-of-range or unknown values raise InvalidConfigurationError and leave this game completely unchanged. When the choice is valid, a Ready or Playing game becomes Abandoned (Won or Lost keep their outcome), and a new Game with a new id and the chosen difficulty_id, width, height and mine_count is returned in its starting state, and the object's fields show it afterwards. When `abandon_game()` is called with valid values Then Closing or leaving the game: if status is Ready or Playing it becomes Abandoned, ended_at is set and elapsed_seconds freezes. A Won, Lost or Abandoned game is left unchanged with no error; nothing is ever scored, and the object's fields show it afterwards. One test function per method.

actions.name: open_cell
actions.description: Opens the cell at zero-based (row, column), and is allowed only while status is Ready or Playing. On the first open of a Ready game, mines_laid becomes True and exactly mine_count mines are placed at random on cells other than the opened one. Every cell's adjacent_mine_count is then set to its mines among the existing up-to-8 neighbours, status becomes Playing and started_at is set. A Hidden safe cell becomes Opened; if its count is 0 the cascade opens Hidden neighbours, repeating through zeros, stopping at numbered cells and skipping Flagged cells. If the cell holds a mine it becomes Detonated, struck_cell_id holds its id, status becomes Lost, ended_at is set and elapsed_seconds freezes. When the last non-mine cell is opened, status becomes Won, ended_at is set, every mine cell is set to Flagged, flags_placed equals mine_count and remaining_mines is 0. Opening an Opened, Detonated or Flagged cell, or opening any cell in a Won, Lost or Abandoned game, changes nothing and raises no error.

actions.name: toggle_flag
actions.description: Switches a Hidden cell to Flagged (flags_placed +1) or a Flagged cell back to Hidden (flags_placed −1), and is allowed only while status is Ready or Playing. Afterwards remaining_mines = mine_count − flags_placed, which may go negative; flags are unlimited. Toggling an Opened or Detonated cell, or any cell in a Won, Lost or Abandoned game, changes nothing and raises no error.

actions.name: chord_cell
actions.description: Applies only to an Opened cell with adjacent_mine_count N ≥ 1 while status is Playing. If exactly N of its neighbours are Flagged, every Hidden neighbour is opened exactly as open_cell would, including cascades, a win, or a loss if a neighbour is a mine (that cell becomes Detonated, struck_cell_id is set and status becomes Lost). If the flag count differs from N, the cell is Hidden, Flagged or a zero cell, or the game is not Playing, nothing changes and no error is raised.

actions.name: tick
actions.description: The clock advancing one second: while status is Playing, elapsed_seconds increases by 1, capped at 999. In any other status nothing changes.

actions.name: restart_game
actions.description: Pressing the smiley. If status is Ready or Playing it becomes Abandoned and ended_at is set; if Won or Lost the outcome is kept. Returns a new Game with a new id and the same difficulty_id, width, height and mine_count, in its starting state.

actions.name: change_difficulty
actions.description: Choosing a difficulty from the menu: beginner gives 9×9 with 10 mines, intermediate 16×16 with 40, expert 30×16 with 99. Custom uses the given width (9–30), height (9–24) and mine_count (10 to (width−1)×(height−1)); out-of-range or unknown values raise InvalidConfigurationError and leave this game completely unchanged. When the choice is valid, a Ready or Playing game becomes Abandoned (Won or Lost keep their outcome), and a new Game with a new id and the chosen difficulty_id, width, height and mine_count is returned in its starting state.

actions.name: abandon_game
actions.description: Closing or leaving the game: if status is Ready or Playing it becomes Abandoned, ended_at is set and elapsed_seconds freezes. A Won, Lost or Abandoned game is left unchanged with no error; nothing is ever scored.

actions.name: record_win
actions.description: Applied automatically when a game is Won. For a standard difficulty (beginner, intermediate, expert) where elapsed_seconds < best_seconds, best_seconds becomes elapsed_seconds and game_id and achieved_at are updated; a slower or equal time keeps the stored best. A custom difficulty, or a difficulty_id differing from this record's, changes nothing.

starting_states.description: Constructed with id, difficulty_id, width, height, mine_count, remaining_mines and created_at: status 'Ready', mines_laid False, flags_placed 0, elapsed_seconds 0, remaining_mines equal to mine_count, started_at, ended_at and struck_cell_id None, events empty. cells holds width×height dicts in row-major order, with zero-based row and column and id f"{row}-{column}" (e.g. '0-0'). Each cell has has_mine False, adjacent_mine_count 0 and state 'Hidden'.
Constructed with id, difficulty_id (beginner, intermediate or expert), game_id, best_seconds and achieved_at from the first win of that difficulty; it holds exactly those values, with events empty.

The mine cell the player opened, causing the loss

deck.title: Rectangular grid with fixed mine count
deck.description: A board is a width×height rectangle of cells and holds exactly the game's mine_count mines once laid.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game configured with width W, height H and mine count M When the mines are laid Then the board has exactly W×H cells and exactly M cells hold a mine

deck.title: Beginner preset
deck.description: Beginner is 9×9 with 10 mines.
deck.given_when_then: Given the player chooses Beginner When the new game is created Then its width is 9, height is 9 and mine count is 10

deck.title: Intermediate preset
deck.description: Intermediate is 16×16 with 40 mines.
deck.given_when_then: Given the player chooses Intermediate When the new game is created Then its width is 16, height is 16 and mine count is 40

deck.title: Expert preset
deck.description: Expert is 30 wide × 16 high with 99 mines.
deck.given_when_then: Given the player chooses Expert When the new game is created Then its width is 30, height is 16 and mine count is 99

deck.title: Custom width range
deck.description: Custom width must be between 9 and 30 inclusive.
deck.given_when_then: Given the player enters a Custom configuration When the width is between 9 and 30 inclusive Then the width is accepted, and When the width is below 9 or above 30 Then the configuration is refused

deck.title: Custom height range
deck.description: Custom height must be between 9 and 24 inclusive.
deck.given_when_then: Given the player enters a Custom configuration When the height is between 9 and 24 inclusive Then the height is accepted, and When the height is below 9 or above 24 Then the configuration is refused

deck.title: Custom mine count range
deck.description: Custom mine count must be between 10 and (width−1)×(height−1) inclusive.
deck.given_when_then: Given a Custom configuration with valid width W and height H When the mine count is between 10 and (W−1)×(H−1) inclusive Then it is accepted, and When it is below 10 or above (W−1)×(H−1) Then the configuration is refused

deck.title: Invalid custom leaves current game unchanged
deck.description: A refused Custom configuration shows a message and does not alter or abandon the current game.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in any status When the player submits a Custom configuration outside the limits Then a validation message is shown and the current game, its board, timer and counter remain unchanged

deck.title: Custom validation message display
deck.description: The refusal is communicated to the player with a visible message.
deck.given_when_then: Given the Custom difficulty dialog When the player submits out-of-range values Then a message explaining the allowed limits is displayed

deck.title: Mines laid on first open
deck.description: No mines exist on the board until the first cell is opened.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready status with no mines laid When the player opens the first cell Then the mines are laid at that moment, and before that moment no cell holds a mine

deck.title: First click is safe
deck.description: The first opened cell never holds a mine.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready status When the player opens any cell as the first open Then that cell holds no mine and the game does not end in a loss

deck.title: Ready to Playing transition
deck.description: The first open moves the game from Ready to Playing.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready status When the player opens a hidden unflagged cell Then the game status becomes Playing

deck.title: Open a hidden unflagged cell
deck.description: Opening a Hidden cell sets its state to Opened.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready or Playing status and a cell in Hidden state When the player opens it Then the cell state becomes Opened (or Detonated if it holds a mine)

deck.title: Neighbour mine count
deck.description: An opened safe cell's number equals the count of mines among its up to 8 neighbours.
deck.given_when_then: Given an interior safe cell with K mines among its 8 neighbours When it is opened Then its adjacent mine count is K (0 to 8)

deck.title: Edge and corner neighbours
deck.description: Edge cells have 5 neighbours and corner cells 3; only existing neighbours are counted.
deck.given_when_then: Given a safe cell on an edge (5 neighbours) or a corner (3 neighbours) When its adjacent mine count is computed Then only the neighbours that exist within the grid are counted

deck.title: Cascade on zero
deck.description: Opening a zero cell automatically opens all its neighbours, repeating for further zeros.
deck.given_when_then: Given a hidden safe cell with adjacent mine count 0 When it is opened Then all its hidden neighbours are opened, and any opened neighbour with count 0 opens its neighbours in turn

deck.title: Cascade stops at numbered cells
deck.description: Numbered cells are opened by a cascade but do not propagate it.
deck.given_when_then: Given a cascade in progress When it opens a cell with adjacent mine count of 1 or more Then that cell is opened and its own neighbours are not opened by the cascade

deck.title: Cascade skips flagged cells
deck.description: A cascade never opens a flagged cell.
deck.given_when_then: Given a cascade in progress and a neighbouring cell in Flagged state When the cascade reaches it Then the cell remains Flagged and is not opened

deck.title: Toggle flag
deck.description: Flagging toggles a hidden cell between Hidden and Flagged.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready or Playing status When the player flags a Hidden cell Then it becomes Flagged, and When the player flags a Flagged cell Then it becomes Hidden

deck.title: Flagged cell cannot be opened
deck.description: Opening a flagged cell is refused until it is unflagged.
deck.given_when_then: Given a cell in Flagged state When the player tries to open it Then the cell stays Flagged and nothing is revealed, and When the player unflags it and opens it Then it is opened

deck.title: Unlimited flags
deck.description: The number of flags is not limited by the mine count.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game whose flags placed already equals its mine count When the player flags another Hidden cell Then the flag is placed

deck.title: Remaining mines counter
deck.description: Remaining mines = total mines − flags placed, which may be negative.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game with M mines and F flags placed When the counter is calculated Then it equals M − F, including negative values when F > M

deck.title: Chord with matching flags
deck.description: Chording an opened number whose adjacent flags equal its number opens all other hidden unflagged neighbours.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Playing status and an Opened cell with number N and exactly N flagged neighbours When the player chords it Then all its Hidden unflagged neighbours are opened (with cascades as applicable)

deck.title: Chord with mismatched flags does nothing
deck.description: If adjacent flags do not equal the number, chording has no effect.
deck.given_when_then: Given an Opened cell with number N and a number of flagged neighbours different from N When the player chords it Then no cell changes state

deck.title: Chord with wrong flag loses
deck.description: If a misplaced flag makes a chord open a mine, the game is lost.
deck.given_when_then: Given an Opened cell with number N and N flagged neighbours, one of which is not a mine When the player chords it Then the unflagged mine neighbour is opened, becomes Detonated and the game status becomes Lost

deck.title: Timer starts at first open
deck.description: The timer starts at the first open and counts whole seconds; it reads 0 before that.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready status with elapsed seconds 0 When the player opens the first cell Then the timer starts and elapsed seconds increases by 1 each second

deck.title: Timer cap at 999
deck.description: Elapsed seconds never exceeds 999.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Playing status with elapsed seconds 999 When further time passes Then elapsed seconds stays at 999

deck.title: Timer freezes on end
deck.description: The timer stops when the game is won or lost.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Playing status When the game becomes Won or Lost Then elapsed seconds is frozen at its current value

deck.title: Opening a mine loses
deck.description: Opening a mine ends the game in a loss and records the struck cell.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Playing status When the player opens a Hidden cell holding a mine Then the cell becomes Detonated, it is recorded as the struck cell and the game status becomes Lost

deck.title: Loss display
deck.description: On loss the struck mine shows on red, all other mines are shown, wrong flags show a crossed mine.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game that has just become Lost When the board is displayed Then the struck mine is drawn on a red background, every other mine is revealed, and each flag on a non-mine cell is drawn as a crossed-out mine

deck.title: Win condition
deck.description: The game is won when every non-mine cell is opened, regardless of flags.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Playing status When the last non-mine cell is opened Then the game status becomes Won whether or not the mines are flagged, and while any non-mine cell is unopened the game is not Won

deck.title: Auto-flag on win
deck.description: On a win all mines become flagged and the remaining-mines counter becomes 0.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game that has just become Won When the win is recorded Then every mine cell is set to Flagged, flags placed equals the mine count and the remaining-mines counter is 0

deck.title: Win display
deck.description: On a win every mine is shown with a flag and the counter displays 000.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game that is Won When the board is displayed Then every mine shows a red pennant flag and the mine counter displays 0

deck.title: New best time
deck.description: A win on a standard difficulty faster than the stored best replaces it.
deck.given_when_then: Given a stored best time of B seconds for a standard difficulty When the player wins a game of that difficulty in T seconds with T < B Then the best time becomes T for that difficulty on this device

deck.title: First win sets best time
deck.description: With no stored best, a standard win becomes the best time.
deck.given_when_then: Given no best time stored for a standard difficulty When the player wins a game of that difficulty in T seconds Then a best time of T is recorded for that difficulty

deck.title: Slower or equal win keeps best
deck.description: A win not faster than the stored best does not change it.
deck.given_when_then: Given a stored best time of B seconds for a standard difficulty When the player wins in T seconds with T >= B Then the best time remains B

deck.title: Custom games record no best time
deck.description: Wins on Custom difficulty never create or update a best time.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game on Custom difficulty When the player wins it Then no best time is created or changed

deck.title: Lost or abandoned games record no best time
deck.description: Only wins can produce a best time.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game that ends Lost or Abandoned When it ends Then no best time is created or changed

deck.title: Board lock after end
deck.description: After a win or loss only a new game is accepted.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Won or Lost status When the player opens, flags or chords any cell Then no cell, counter or timer changes, and When the player starts a new game Then it is accepted

deck.title: Opening an opened cell is ignored
deck.description: Opening an already opened cell changes nothing silently.
deck.given_when_then: Given a cell in Opened state When the player opens it Then nothing changes and no message is shown

deck.title: Flagging an opened cell is ignored
deck.description: Flagging an opened cell changes nothing silently.
deck.given_when_then: Given a cell in Opened state When the player toggles a flag on it Then the cell stays Opened, flags placed is unchanged and no message is shown

deck.title: Chording a hidden cell is ignored
deck.description: Chording a hidden cell changes nothing silently.
deck.given_when_then: Given a cell in Hidden state When the player chords it Then no cell changes state and no message is shown

deck.title: Restart via smiley
deck.description: Pressing the smiley abandons the current game without score and deals a fresh board of the same difficulty.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready or Playing status When the player presses the smiley Then that game becomes Abandoned with no best time recorded and a new Ready game of the same difficulty with all cells Hidden, timer 0 and counter equal to its mine count is created

deck.title: Smiley after end starts new game
deck.description: Pressing the smiley on a Won or Lost game starts a fresh game without altering the finished one.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Won or Lost status When the player presses the smiley Then the finished game keeps its outcome and a new Ready game of the same difficulty is created

deck.title: Changing difficulty
deck.description: Choosing a difficulty abandons the current game and starts a new one with the chosen settings.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready or Playing status When the player chooses a valid difficulty Then the current game becomes Abandoned with no score and a new Ready game with the chosen width, height and mine count is created

deck.title: Leaving abandons the game
deck.description: Closing the game abandons any game in progress and records nothing.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready or Playing status When the player closes the game Then it becomes Abandoned and no best time is recorded

deck.title: Abandon only from Ready or Playing
deck.description: Only Ready or Playing games can become Abandoned; Won and Lost are final.
deck.given_when_then: Given a game in Ready or Playing status When it is abandoned Then its status becomes Abandoned, and Given a game in Won or Lost status When an abandon is triggered Then its status remains Won or Lost

deck.title: Game status transitions

SPEC-ACT-GAME.test_source:
import copy

import pytest

from src.domain.game import Game


CREATED_AT = "2024-01-01T00:00:00"
STARTED_AT = "2024-01-01T00:00:05"
ENDED_AT = "2024-01-01T00:01:00"

# Board B (9x9, 10 mines): bottom row columns 0-6 are mines, plus a ring of three
# mines (7,7), (7,8), (8,7) enclosing the safe corner (8,8), whose count is 3.
# (8,8) touches only mines, so no cascade can ever reach it, so the game never
# wins by accident unless (8,8) itself is opened.
BOARD_B_MINES = {(8, c) for c in range(7)} | {(7, 7), (7, 8), (8, 7)}


def make_game(difficulty_id="beginner", width=9, height=9, mine_count=10, game_id="g1"):
    return Game(
        id=game_id,
        difficulty_id=difficulty_id,
        width=width,
        height=height,
        mine_count=mine_count,
        remaining_mines=mine_count,
        created_at=CREATED_AT,
    )


def neighbours(width, height, r, c):
    for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
        for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
            if dr == 0 and dc == 0:
                continue
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width:
                yield nr, nc


def build_cells(width, height, mines, opened=(), flagged=(), detonated=()):
    cells = []
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            count = sum(1 for n in neighbours(width, height, r, c) if n in mines)
            if (r, c) in detonated:
                state = "Detonated"
            elif (r, c) in opened:
                state = "Opened"
            elif (r, c) in flagged:
                state = "Flagged"
            else:
                state = "Hidden"
            cells.append(
                {
                    "id": f"{r}-{c}",
                    "row": r,
                    "column": c,
                    "has_mine": (r, c) in mines,
                    "adjacent_mine_count": count,
                    "state": state,
                }
            )
    return cells


def arrange(game, mines=BOARD_B_MINES, opened=(), flagged=(), detonated=(),
            status="Playing", elapsed=42, struck=None, ended_at=None):
    game.cells = build_cells(game.width, game.height, set(mines), set(opened),
                             set(flagged), set(detonated))
    game.status = status
    game.mines_laid = True
    game.started_at = STARTED_AT
    game.ended_at = ended_at
    game.struck_cell_id = struck
    game.elapsed_seconds = elapsed
    game.flags_placed = len(set(flagged))
    game.remaining_mines = game.mine_count - len(set(flagged))
    return game


def cell(game, r, c):
    return game.cells[r * game.width + c]


def snapshot(game):
    return copy.deepcopy(
        {
            "id": game.id,
            "difficulty_id": game.difficulty_id,
            "width": game.width,
            "height": game.height,
            "mine_count": game.mine_count,
            "status": game.status,
            "mines_laid": game.mines_laid,
            "flags_placed": game.flags_placed,
            "remaining_mines": game.remaining_mines,
            "elapsed_seconds": game.elapsed_seconds,
            "started_at": game.started_at,
            "ended_at": game.ended_at,
            "struck_cell_id": game.struck_cell_id,
            "cells": game.cells,
        }
    )


def all_safe_board_b():
    return {(r, c) for r in range(9) for c in range(9)} - BOARD_B_MINES


def assert_starting_state(new, difficulty_id, width, height, mine_count):
    assert isinstance(new, Game)
    assert new.difficulty_id == difficulty_id
    assert new.width == width
    assert new.height == height
    assert new.mine_count == mine_count
    assert new.status == "Ready"
    assert new.mines_laid is False
    assert new.flags_placed == 0
    assert new.elapsed_seconds == 0
    assert new.remaining_mines == mine_count
    assert new.started_at is None
    assert new.ended_at is None
    assert new.struck_cell_id is None
    assert len(new.cells) == width * height
    for i, cl in enumerate(new.cells):
        r, c = divmod(i, width)
        assert cl["id"] == f"{r}-{c}"
        assert cl["row"] == r and cl["column"] == c
        assert cl["has_mine"] is False
        assert cl["adjacent_mine_count"] == 0
        assert cl["state"] == "Hidden"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- construction

def test_new_game_starts_ready_with_hidden_empty_grid():
    game = make_game(difficulty_id="expert", width=30, height=16, mine_count=99)
    # Freshly constructed: Ready, nothing laid, counters at their start values,
    # 30*16 = 480 hidden mine-free cells in row-major order with ids "row-column".
    assert_starting_state(game, "expert", 30, 16, 99)
    assert game.id == "g1"
    assert game.created_at == CREATED_AT
    assert game.events == []
    assert game.cells[0]["id"] == "0-0"
    assert game.cells[1]["id"] == "0-1"
    assert game.cells[30]["id"] == "1-0"
    assert game.cells[-1]["id"] == "15-29"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- open_cell

def test_open_cell_first_open_lays_mines_and_starts_playing():
    game = make_game()
    # Before the first open no cell holds a mine.
    assert not any(cl["has_mine"] for cl in game.cells)

    game.open_cell(row=4, column=4)

    # Mines are laid now: exactly 10 of the 81 cells, never the opened one.
    assert game.mines_laid is True
    assert sum(1 for cl in game.cells if cl["has_mine"]) == 10
    assert cell(game, 4, 4)["has_mine"] is False
    assert cell(game, 4, 4)["state"] == "Opened"
    # Every cell's count equals the mines among its existing neighbours.
    mines = {(cl["row"], cl["column"]) for cl in game.cells if cl["has_mine"]}
    for cl in game.cells:
        expected = sum(1 for n in neighbours(9, 9, cl["row"], cl["column"]) if n in mines)
        assert cl["adjacent_mine_count"] == expected
    # A safe first open never loses; no mine is opened or detonated.
    assert not any(cl["state"] == "Detonated" for cl in game.cells)
    assert not any(cl["has_mine"] and cl["state"] == "Opened" for cl in game.cells)
    assert game.struck_cell_id is None
    # If the opened cell is a zero, the cascade opened all its neighbours.
    if cell(game, 4, 4)["adjacent_mine_count"] == 0:
        for r, c in neighbours(9, 9, 4, 4):
            assert cell(game, r, c)["state"] == "Opened"
    # Status is Playing, unless the cascade happened to open every safe cell (Won).
    safe_left = any(not cl["has_mine"] and cl["state"] != "Opened" for cl in game.cells)
    assert game.status == ("Playing" if safe_left else "Won")
    assert game.started_at is not None


def test_open_cell_numbered_cell_opens_only_itself():
    game = arrange(make_game())
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.open_cell(row=7, column=0)

    # (7,0) neighbours (8,0),(8,1) are mines -> count 2, so no cascade:
    # only (7,0) changes from Hidden to Opened; the game stays Playing.
    assert cell(game, 7, 0)["state"] == "Opened"
    assert cell(game, 7, 0)["adjacent_mine_count"] == 2
    changed = [i for i, cl in enumerate(game.cells) if cl != before["cells"][i]]
    assert changed == [7 * 9 + 0]
    assert game.status == "Playing"


def test_open_cell_zero_cascades_stops_at_numbers_and_skips_flags():
    game = arrange(make_game(), flagged={(3, 3)})

    game.open_cell(row=0, column=0)

    # Rows 0-5 are all zeros, row 6 cols 0-5 zeros, (6,6..8) and row 7 cols 0-6
    # numbered: the cascade opens every safe cell it can reach. (8,8) touches
    # only mines so it is never reached; flagged (3,3) is skipped and stays Flagged.
    expected_opened = all_safe_board_b() - {(8, 8), (3, 3)}
    for r in range(9):
        for c in range(9):
            st = cell(game, r, c)["state"]
            if (r, c) in expected_opened:
                assert st == "Opened"
            elif (r, c) == (3, 3):
                assert st == "Flagged"
            else:
                assert st == "Hidden"
    # (8,8) is still hidden, so not Won; no mine opened, so not Lost.
    assert game.status == "Playing"
    assert game.flags_placed == 1
    assert game.remaining_mines == 9


def test_open_cell_on_mine_loses():
    game = arrange(make_game(), elapsed=42)

    game.open_cell(row=8, column=0)

    # (8,0) holds a mine -> Detonated, recorded as struck, game Lost, timer frozen.
    assert cell(game, 8, 0)["state"] == "Detonated"
    assert game.struck_cell_id == "8-0"
    assert game.status == "Lost"
    assert game.ended_at is not None
    assert game.elapsed_seconds == 42


def test_open_cell_last_safe_cell_wins_and_flags_mines():
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened=all_safe_board_b() - {(8, 8)}, elapsed=42)

    game.open_cell(row=8, column=8)

    # (8,8) is the last unopened safe cell (count 3) -> Opened, game Won.
    assert cell(game, 8, 8)["state"] == "Opened"
    assert game.status == "Won"
    assert game.ended_at is not None
    assert game.elapsed_seconds == 42
    # Every mine is auto-flagged; counter reads 0.
    for r, c in BOARD_B_MINES:
        assert cell(game, r, c)["state"] == "Flagged"
    assert game.flags_placed == 10
    assert game.remaining_mines == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("target", [(0, 0), (8, 0)])
def test_open_cell_on_opened_or_flagged_cell_is_ignored(target):
    # (0,0) is Opened (safe), (8,0) is a Flagged mine.
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened={(0, 0)}, flagged={(8, 0)})
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.open_cell(row=target[0], column=target[1])

    # Opening an Opened or Flagged cell changes nothing and raises nothing.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["Won", "Lost", "Abandoned"])
def test_open_cell_in_finished_game_is_ignored(status):
    game = arrange(make_game(), status=status, ended_at=ENDED_AT)
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.open_cell(row=0, column=0)

    # The board is locked: (0,0) stays Hidden and no field changes.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("row,column,ok", [(8, 8, True), (9, 0, False), (0, 9, False), (-1, 0, False)])
def test_open_cell_outside_grid_is_refused(row, column, ok):
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened=all_safe_board_b() - {(8, 8), (0, 0)})
    if ok:
        # (8,8) is the last valid row/column: accepted, the cell opens.
        game.open_cell(row=row, column=column)
        assert cell(game, 8, 8)["state"] == "Opened"
    else:
        before = snapshot(game)
        with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
            game.open_cell(row=row, column=column)
        # Row/column 9 or -1 is outside the 9x9 grid.
        assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "CellNotFoundError"
        assert snapshot(game) == before


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- toggle_flag

@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["Ready", "Playing"])
def test_toggle_flag_switches_hidden_and_flagged(status):
    game = make_game()
    if status == "Playing":
        arrange(game)

    game.toggle_flag(row=0, column=0)
    # Hidden -> Flagged, flags 0 -> 1, counter 10 - 1 = 9; status unchanged.
    assert cell(game, 0, 0)["state"] == "Flagged"
    assert game.flags_placed == 1
    assert game.remaining_mines == 9
    assert game.status == status

    game.toggle_flag(row=0, column=0)
    # Flagged -> Hidden, flags back to 0, counter 10.
    assert cell(game, 0, 0)["state"] == "Hidden"
    assert game.flags_placed == 0
    assert game.remaining_mines == 10
    assert game.status == status


def test_toggle_flag_is_unlimited_and_counter_goes_negative():
    flags = {(0, c) for c in range(9)} | {(1, 0)}  # 10 flags = mine_count
    game = arrange(make_game(), flagged=flags)

    game.toggle_flag(row=2, column=0)

    # An 11th flag is still placed: counter 10 - 11 = -1.
    assert cell(game, 2, 0)["state"] == "Flagged"
    assert game.flags_placed == 11
    assert game.remaining_mines == -1


def test_toggle_flag_on_opened_cell_is_ignored():
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened={(0, 0)})
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.toggle_flag(row=0, column=0)

    # An Opened cell cannot be flagged: nothing changes, no error.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["Won", "Lost", "Abandoned"])
def test_toggle_flag_in_finished_game_is_ignored(status):
    game = arrange(make_game(), status=status, ended_at=ENDED_AT)
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.toggle_flag(row=0, column=0)

    # Locked board: (0,0) stays Hidden, flags and counter unchanged.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("row,column,ok", [(0, 8, True), (0, 9, False), (9, 0, False)])
def test_toggle_flag_outside_grid_is_refused(row, column, ok):
    game = arrange(make_game())
    if ok:
        game.toggle_flag(row=row, column=column)
        # Column 8 is inside the grid: the Hidden cell becomes Flagged.
        assert cell(game, 0, 8)["state"] == "Flagged"
        assert game.flags_placed == 1
    else:
        with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
            game.toggle_flag(row=row, column=column)
        # Column/row 9 is outside the 9x9 grid.
        assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "CellNotFoundError"
        assert game.flags_placed == 0


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ chord_cell

def test_chord_cell_with_matching_flags_opens_neighbours_and_cascades():
    # (6,6) is Opened with count 1 (only mine neighbour is (7,7)), (7,7) flagged.
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened={(6, 6)}, flagged={(7, 7)})
    assert cell(game, 6, 6)["adjacent_mine_count"] == 1

    game.chord_cell(row=6, column=6)

    # 1 flag == N=1: hidden neighbours (5,5),(5,6),(5,7),(6,5),(6,7),(7,5),(7,6)
    # open; zeros among them cascade over the whole safe area. (8,8) touches only
    # mines and stays Hidden, so the game is still Playing; (7,7) stays Flagged.
    expected_opened = all_safe_board_b() - {(8, 8)}
    for r in range(9):
        for c in range(9):
            st = cell(game, r, c)["state"]
            if (r, c) in expected_opened:
                assert st == "Opened"
            elif (r, c) == (7, 7):
                assert st == "Flagged"
            else:
                assert st == "Hidden"
    assert game.status == "Playing"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("flags", [set(), {(7, 7), (5, 5)}])
def test_chord_cell_with_mismatched_flags_changes_nothing(flags):
    # Same as the matching case but with 0 or 2 flags around (6,6) (N=1).
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened={(6, 6)}, flagged=flags)
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.chord_cell(row=6, column=6)

    # Flag count differs from N: no cell changes, no error.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


def test_chord_cell_with_wrong_flag_loses():
    # (6,6) N=1, but the single flag is on safe (5,5); mine (7,7) is Hidden.
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened={(6, 6)}, flagged={(5, 5)})

    game.chord_cell(row=6, column=6)

    # 1 flag == N: hidden neighbours open, including mine (7,7) -> Detonated, Lost.
    assert cell(game, 7, 7)["state"] == "Detonated"
    assert game.struck_cell_id == "7-7"
    assert game.status == "Lost"
    assert game.ended_at is not None
    assert cell(game, 5, 5)["state"] == "Flagged"


def test_chord_cell_on_hidden_cell_is_ignored():
    game = arrange(make_game(), flagged={(7, 7)})
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.chord_cell(row=6, column=6)

    # (6,6) is Hidden: chording it changes nothing.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


def test_chord_cell_on_zero_cell_is_ignored():
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened={(0, 0)})
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.chord_cell(row=0, column=0)

    # (0,0) is Opened with count 0: chord does not apply.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["Won", "Lost", "Abandoned"])
def test_chord_cell_when_not_playing_is_ignored(status):
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened={(6, 6)}, flagged={(7, 7)}, status=status,
                   ended_at=ENDED_AT)
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.chord_cell(row=6, column=6)

    # Flags match, but the game is not Playing: nothing changes.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("row,column,ok", [(8, 0, True), (9, 0, False), (0, 9, False)])
def test_chord_cell_outside_grid_is_refused(row, column, ok):
    game = arrange(make_game())
    before = snapshot(game)
    if ok:
        # (8,0) is inside the grid (a Hidden cell): ignored, no error.
        game.chord_cell(row=row, column=column)
        assert snapshot(game) == before
    else:
        with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
            game.chord_cell(row=row, column=column)
        assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "CellNotFoundError"
        assert snapshot(game) == before


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------ tick

@pytest.mark.parametrize("start,expected", [(5, 6), (998, 999), (999, 999)])
def test_tick_advances_playing_timer_capped_at_999(start, expected):
    game = arrange(make_game(), elapsed=start)

    game.tick()

    # Playing: +1 per tick, never beyond 999.
    assert game.elapsed_seconds == expected
    assert game.status == "Playing"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["Won", "Lost", "Abandoned"])
def test_tick_in_finished_game_changes_nothing(status):
    game = arrange(make_game(), status=status, elapsed=42, ended_at=ENDED_AT)
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.tick()

    # Not Playing: the timer stays at 42.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


def test_tick_in_ready_game_changes_nothing():
    game = make_game()
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.tick()

    # Ready: the timer has not started and stays at 0.
    assert snapshot(game) == before
    assert game.elapsed_seconds == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- restart_game

@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["Ready", "Playing"])
def test_restart_game_abandons_active_game_and_returns_new_one(status):
    game = make_game(difficulty_id="intermediate", width=16, height=16, mine_count=40)
    if status == "Playing":
        arrange(game, mines={(15, c) for c in range(16)} | {(14, c) for c in range(16)}
                | {(13, c) for c in range(8)})

    new = game.restart_game()

    # Active game -> Abandoned with ended_at set.
    assert game.status == "Abandoned"
    assert game.ended_at is not None
    # New Ready game, new id, same configuration, starting state.
    assert new is not game
    assert new.id != game.id
    assert_starting_state(new, "intermediate", 16, 16, 40)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["Won", "Lost"])
def test_restart_game_after_end_keeps_outcome(status):
    game = arrange(make_game(), status=status, ended_at=ENDED_AT,
                   struck="8-0" if status == "Lost" else None,
                   detonated={(8, 0)} if status == "Lost" else ())
    before = snapshot(game)

    new = game.restart_game()

    # Finished game keeps its outcome and every field.
    assert snapshot(game) == before
    assert game.status == status
    assert new.id != game.id
    assert_starting_state(new, "beginner", 9, 9, 10)


# ----------------------------------------------------------- change_difficulty

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "difficulty_id,width,height,mine_count",
    [("beginner", 9, 9, 10), ("intermediate", 16, 16, 40), ("expert", 30, 16, 99)],
)
def test_change_difficulty_presets(difficulty_id, width, height, mine_count):
    game = make_game(difficulty_id="custom", width=12, height=12, mine_count=20)

    new = game.change_difficulty(difficulty_id=difficulty_id, width=None, height=None,
                                 mine_count=None)

    # Ready game -> Abandoned; new game has the preset's size and mines.
    assert game.status == "Abandoned"
    assert new.id != game.id
    assert_starting_state(new, difficulty_id, width, height, mine_count)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "difficulty_id,width,height,mine_count",
    [
        ("custom", 8, 9, 10),
        ("custom", 31, 9, 10),
        ("custom", 9, 8, 10),
        ("custom", 9, 25, 10),
        ("custom", 9, 9, 9),
        ("custom", 9, 9, 65),
        ("custom", 30, 24, 668),
        ("master", 9, 9, 10),
    ],
)
def test_change_difficulty_invalid_is_refused_and_game_unchanged(difficulty_id, width,
                                                                 height, mine_count):
    game = arrange(make_game(), opened={(0, 0)}, flagged={(8, 0)}, elapsed=42)
    before = snapshot(game)

    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        game.change_difficulty(difficulty_id=difficulty_id, width=width, height=height,
                               mine_count=mine_count)

    # Each case is one step beyond a limit (or an unknown id): refused.
    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "InvalidConfigurationError"
    assert str(exc_info.value) != ""
    # The current game, board, timer and counter are untouched.
    assert snapshot(game) == before


def test_change_difficulty_refusal_message_states_width_limits():

    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "InvalidConfigurationError"
    assert "9" in str(exc_info.value) and "30" in str(exc_info.value)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- abandon_game

def test_abandon_game_from_ready():
    game = make_game()

    game.abandon_game()

    # Ready -> Abandoned, ended_at set, timer stays 0.
    assert game.status == "Abandoned"
    assert game.ended_at is not None
    assert game.elapsed_seconds == 0


def test_abandon_game_from_playing_freezes_timer():
    game = arrange(make_game(), elapsed=42)

    game.abandon_game()
    game.tick()

    # Playing -> Abandoned; the timer is frozen at 42 even when time passes.
    assert game.status == "Abandoned"
    assert game.ended_at is not None
    assert game.elapsed_seconds == 42


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["Won", "Lost", "Abandoned"])
def test_abandon_game_when_finished_changes_nothing(status):
    game = arrange(make_game(), status=status, ended_at=ENDED_AT, elapsed=42)
    before = snapshot(game)

    game.abandon_game()

    # Won/Lost/Abandoned stay as they are, no error.
    assert snapshot(game) == before
    assert game.status == status
